data.message: I voluntarily commit to 18 tons; this is individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-run. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
